title: Bump opum-lore federated pin from v0.7.0 to v0.8.0
description: npm dist-tags.latest for @opum-ai/lore moved to 0.8.0 (confirmed live, plus all 6 platform packages). Bump marketplace.json's opum-lore ref and the federated-pin-baselines.json entry to match. Content no-op: skills/ subtree 2998f74d077845f8ad73f83aa296e37e034378a4 is byte-identical to the current v0.7.0 baseline (independently re-resolved via GitHub API: tag object cfd84892a21d4ccebdeb347dc533bc208a82e818 -> commit 4d4a1bfba1a1e46d362f0ab2370e250e47c8253c -> root tree 86c8c175b68466d84f272784f77c02c6fdc60c52 -> skills subtree 2998f74d...). plugin.json at the tag self-declares 0.8.0. Per OMARK-43/44 baseline convention, moving the pin requires moving the baseline's ref/verifiedAt/note in the same commit even though the tree SHA itself does not change.

acceptanceCriteria.text: federated-pin-baselines.json opum-lore.ref is v0.8.0 with verifiedAt and note updated to record the independent re-verification
scripts/check-federated-content.mjs passes against the new pin+baseline
npm run check (or repo equivalent) and lore check both exit 0

finalSummary: Bumped opum-lore federated pin v0.7.0 -> v0.8.0 (PR #136, merge commit e8ebf3d). npm dist-tags.latest confirmed independently as 0.8.0 on the main package and all 6 platform packages before bumping. Tag chain re-resolved fresh via GitHub API at bump time (not reused from the earlier tag-cut check): tag object cfd8489... -> commit 4d4a1bf... -> root tree 86c8c17... -> skills subtree 2998f74d..., byte-identical to the existing v0.7.0 baseline, so federated-pin-baselines.json trees.skills did not change, only ref/verifiedAt/note. Unexpected finding during validation: CI's lore check job installs lore at the version this repo's own opum-lore pin declares, so this exact PR was the first thing to exercise lore 0.8.0's new committed-schema drift check here -- it failed in CI (exit 6, all 7 profile schemas) even though it passed locally against my then-installed lore 0.7.0. Root-caused (not just re-run): installed lore@0.8.0 locally, reproduced the identical failure, ran lore schema export to regenerate the 7 committed schemas, and lore check passed clean afterward. Both commits landed in PR #136 before merge; all three required checks (check manifests, Tracker integrity, lore check) green on the final head SHA 2b8fb07. Process note: acceptance criteria and this closure should have been recorded inside PR #136 before merging per the close-in-the-landing-PR rule; they were instead applied after merge in a small follow-up chore/OMARK-63-close-task branch/PR, which is the deviation to avoid next time.
